about: The artifact tag as read off raw text, by the server (findArtifactLineOutsideBlocks) and the SDK (artifactTag). Malloy's lexer and tag parser are the authority: a note is the tag when it sets `artifact` as a top-level property, wherever it sits among the note's properties; a ##| opener consumes its whole line, and a block closes only at a later line's start, at the opener's column. `tag` is the tag's lines, each trimmed, or null for none. `server` overrides `tag` for the server alone, with `why`.

cases.name: a one-line ## tag
a ##| block tag over several lines
cases.source:
##| artifact { kind=notebook
  tiles=[
    "s -> v"
  ]
}
|##
run: x

cases.name: a ##| block tag in CRLF
cases.source:
##| artifact { kind=notebook
  tiles=[
    "s -> v"
  ]
}
|##
run: x

cases.name: a one-line ## tag in CRLF
a same-line |## does not close the block: it runs to the next closer
cases.source:
##| artifact { kind=dashboard } |##
source: s is t
##|(markdown) intro
hi
|##
run: x

cases.name: a same-line |## with no later closer leaves the block unclosed
cases.why: The file does not compile (`unclosed-block-annotation`). The server's write gate still reads the opener as a tag so the write reaches the compiler, whose error says to close the block, instead of being refused as untagged.

cases.name: a |## inside a string in the block body does not close it
cases.source:
##| artifact { kind=notebook title="a |## b"
}
|##
run: x

cases.name: a |## at a line start inside a SQL string is no opener and hides nothing
cases.source:
## artifact { kind=dashboard }
source: s is duckdb.sql("""
|##
""")

cases.name: a |## after // on the opener line is still the opener's
a closer indented past the opener's column does not close it
a tag-like line inside a ##|" block body is prose
a tile's kind=text is inside the tag, not a tag of its own
cases.source:
## artifact { kind=notebook tiles=[intro { kind=text }, "s -> v"] }
##|(markdown) intro
# Hi
|##
run: x

cases.name: artifact after another property on a ## line
cases.source:
## dashboard { columns=2 } artifact { kind=dashboard tiles=["s -> v"] }
run: x
tag: ## dashboard { columns=2 } artifact { kind=dashboard tiles=["s -> v"] }

cases.name: artifact before another property on a ## line
cases.source:
## artifact { kind=dashboard tiles=["s -> v"] } dashboard { columns=2 }
run: x
tag: ## artifact { kind=dashboard tiles=["s -> v"] } dashboard { columns=2 }

cases.name: artifact as a dotted path
a ##| block whose artifact property is on a later line
a ##| block whose opener line sets artifact second
cases.source:
##| dashboard { columns=2 } artifact { kind=notebook
}
|##
run: x

cases.name: artifact as a quoted string value is no tag
artifact inside a single-quoted string is no tag
artifact as a bare value is no tag
artifact nested inside another property is no tag
artifact under another property's dotted path is no tag
artifact after a # comment on the tag line is no tag
a routed note that mentions artifact is no tag
a query-level # tag is not the model-level tag
a first property whose name starts with a digit
a first property whose name starts with a Latin-extended letter
a Latin-extended letter joined to artifact makes another name
artifact written as a backtick-quoted name
artifact as a backtick-quoted value is no tag
artifact after a deleted property
artifact after a -... that clears every property
a ##| block tag whose first line is a # comment
a ##| block tag whose opener line is a # comment
##artifact with no space is routed, not a tag
##|artifact with no space is routed, not a tag
an untagged file
